## Winner of 2026 Best Bank in Haymarket/Gainesville!


We are excited to announce Virginia National Bank's Haymarket branch was voted the **2026 BEST BANK in Haymarket/Gainesville Lifestyle Magazine** !


Our employees deserve the attention and provide a high-level of customer service that sets VNB apart from other banks. We cannot thank them enough for their dedication to give our clients the best banking experience!


**Thank you to our valued clients for voting and presenting VNB with this honor!**
